homepage.description.message: Docs & resources for my Jeedom plugins

homepage.hero.subtitle.message: Showcase, documentation and resources for my Jeedom plugins.

homepage.features.plugins.desc.message: Quick access to the list + detailed pages.

plugin.lumina.description.message: Lumina centralizes and controls all the lights in your Jeedom setup, regardless of the protocol used (Hue, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter, Wi-Fi…).

plugin.matter.description.message: Plugin to integrate and control Matter-compatible devices with the universal home automation standard.

plugin.telejee.description.message: Control your TVs and multimedia devices directly from Jeedom via local network — commands, apps, volume and scenarios.

plugin.jeeloc.description.message: Centralize multiple locations in a Jeedom widget with interactive OpenStreetMap map, automatic geocoding and distance calculation.

plugin.mystr0m.description.message: Full integration of myStrom and Dingz devices in Jeedom — local control, no cloud required.

plugin.ioscloud.description.message: iCloud / Find My integration: device sync, location, battery status and Jeedom automations.

plugin.ics.description.message: Turn your Google, iCloud or CalDAV calendar into a home automation engine for Jeedom: automatically trigger actions and scenarios from your calendar events.

plugin.switchbot.description.message: SwitchBot integration via API: states, commands, automatic device synchronization.

plugin.groupe.description.message: Plugin for creating a widget showing the state of a device group.

plugin.TaskLauncher.description.message: Plugin for creating alarm clock devices, clocks, events and launching customizable actions and scenarios.

plugin.telco.description.message: This plugin lets you create virtual remotes and assign actions (single, message, scenario…) to buttons.

plugin.swissmeteo.description.message: Swiss weather plugin: forecasts, current conditions and alerts from MeteoSwiss for Jeedom.

plugin.tools.description.message: Plugin bundling several Jeedom interface tools: MyHome (plan-based interface builder), device cards, specialized widgets and templates.

plugin.whatwatt.description.message: This plugin integrates the WhatWatt connected energy meter into Jeedom to track consumption, production, voltage, current and electrical energy.

plugin.ntfybridge.description.message: Bidirectional communication between Jeedom and ntfy. Receive rich alerts and control your home automation by message from your phone.

plugin.icon.description.message: Add, install, uninstall and preview custom icon packs in Jeedom.

plugin.Pingserver.description.message: Monitor your network devices availability with ping and receive alerts on state changes.
